title: Quenched SLE Universality for Weakly Disordered FK–Ising Interfaces
summary: We prove that critical FK–Ising interfaces with sufficiently weak, symmetric, independent two-valued bond disorder converge to chordal SLE 16/3 . The disorder strength is fixed as the mesh tends to zero, and convergence of the conditional curve laws holds in probability over the environment.
family_title: Random-cluster interfaces: critical, disordered, thermal, and natural-time scaling

review.reason: Proves convergence of weakly disordered FK-Ising interfaces to SLE16/3 under quenched disorder.
